bug_semantics: When AuthRequireGuestsToLogin is enabled, POST /api/ValidateArgumentType remains callable without UserFromApiCall or checkDashboardAccess. After the handler began resolving binding_id and argument_name against live action bindings, unauthenticated callers could use 200-vs-CodeNotFound (and earlier distinct description strings) as an oracle to enumerate existing bindings and argument names.
flaw_origin: 09e1f0f984846660c8b04fda9e2f546b3f6ee40d first added binding_id/argument_name to ValidateArgumentTypeRequest and wrote the unauthenticated FindBindingByID plus argument-name lookup in ValidateArgumentType. Parent 5d061eb1a0ddf7649d451051d8cad5668b09b341 already had checkDashboardAccess on neighboring data-returning endpoints, but ValidateArgumentType only ran TypeSafetyCheck on value/type and could not disclose bindings. Later 8e2db0ad82e73da5a2484498f79c8cfeaf88a3d9 and bb14c5da3e64b03f207c7f38139eb60e97c278fc refactored that lookup and switched missing-binding/argument replies to CodeNotFound; they did not originate the oracle. a3865704c854061452a4ab5f6d95de3312698ccd added dashboard and per-binding authorization.
